details.description: GPT-4.1 nano is OpenAI's fastest and most cost-efficient GPT-4.1 variant, built for instruction following and tool calling with minimal latency and no reasoning step. This catalog entry is the gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14 snapshot as exposed for fine-tuning, supporting supervised fine-tuning and direct preference optimization to create a custom model on top of it. OpenAI's deprecations page lists this fine-tuning base for shutdown on October 23, 2026, with gpt-5.6-luna named as the recommended replacement; because the underlying gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14 snapshot itself is deprecated on that same date, inference on fine-tuned models built from it stops then too, per OpenAI's fine-tuning deprecation policy. Knowledge cutoff is June 1, 2024.
advantages: OpenAI's fine-tuning guide lists gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14 as supporting both supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and direct preference optimization (DPO).
OpenAI's model page positions it as the fastest, most cost-efficient GPT-4.1 model for instruction following and tool calling.
disadvantages: OpenAI's deprecations page schedules this fine-tuning base model (ft-gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14) for shutdown on October 23, 2026, after which new fine-tuning jobs on it are no longer possible.
OpenAI's model page recommends starting with GPT-5 nano instead for more complex tasks.
use_cases: Creating a lightweight custom fine-tuned model for simple, latency-sensitive instruction-following or tool-calling tasks.

notes: Deprecations page lists this exact fine-tuning base under 'We are also removing fine-tuned versions as below' as ft-gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14, shutdown October 23, 2026, matching the catalog's deprecation_date. Recommended replacement gpt-5.6-luna is named on that page but I could not find an independent page describing gpt-5.6-luna itself, so did not describe it further. Catalog facts list only text_input/text_output modality for this fine-tuning entry, while the general gpt-4.1-nano model page also lists image input for normal chat use; kept the catalog's modality per instructions.
